rules.rule_1_mother: Retain the exact frozen industry-neutral small and large circulating-market-value mother events; the size lane is not a forecast direction.

rule_2_event_corridor.definition: Use the mother session and the next four consecutive market sessions with valid, unchanged coordinate lineage.
rule_2_event_corridor.ceiling: maximum coord_high across the five formation sessions
rule_2_event_corridor.floor: minimum coord_low across the five formation sessions
rule_2_event_corridor.fail_closed: Reject the event if any of the five required market sessions is missing, invalid, or crosses coordinate lineage.

rule_3_price_acceptance.pretrigger_failure: Reject the event if two consecutive valid closes strictly below the frozen corridor floor occur before the first qualifying acceptance close.

rule_4_causal_market_opportunity.pass_if: existing market_regime is BULL OR both repair inequalities are true

rule_5_execution_and_exit.entry: First legal buyable open in the next three market sessions after the qualifying close.
rule_5_execution_and_exit.failure_exit_signal: Two consecutive valid completed closes strictly below the frozen corridor ceiling after entry.
rule_5_execution_and_exit.failure_exit: First legal sellable open after the failure signal and after T+1 is satisfied.
rule_5_execution_and_exit.time_exit: First legal sellable open at or after entry market-session index plus 120.
rule_5_execution_and_exit.corporate_actions: fail closed on blocking event or coordinate-lineage change

gate_sequence.stage_1: Build qualifying entries and completed exits without producing annual or pooled return aggregates.
gate_sequence.breadth_failure_action: Close this exact rule without annual return aggregation and do not rescue thresholds.
gate_sequence.stage_2_if_breadth_passes: Produce exactly one annual development aggregation.
gate_sequence.validation_open_condition: Only if every development-year breadth, mean, and median gate passes.
